nodes.name: Create calendar event
nodes.notes: GOOGLE_CALENDAR_ID is the n8n environment variable holding the target calendar's id (Calendar Settings -> Integrate calendar -> Calendar ID; the same one the ICS URL in /settings points at). Needs a Google Calendar OAuth2 credential with calendar write scope, authorized once through n8n's UI -- an API key alone cannot complete that OAuth consent flow.

parameters.query: UPDATE tasks SET google_event_id = $1, external_uid = $2 WHERE id = $3::uuid

nodes.name: Save event id
nodes.notes: Also writes external_uid = the event's iCalUID, not just google_event_id -- so when ICS Sync (0019) polls the same calendar back, ON CONFLICT (source_id, external_uid) matches this exact row and updates it instead of inserting a duplicate task for the event this workflow just created.
